answer: An identity bond that decays like karst under rain stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond losing 5 percent per epoch unless verified work tops it up. A marble-steady honest agent pays once and keeps its bond whole by working. A gale of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 bonds worth 50,000 POA, all eroding at once, and each renewal round costs 2,500 POA more. Fakes bleed money; one honest agent pays once.
